title: 第4章 暴露了？
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
只是到门口的时候，庄静白起身，走到陆沉面前，拍了拍他的肩膀。

    “陆沉兄弟，是嫂子当时情绪上头了，对林天的恨，不该撒在你身上，嫂子给你道歉。”

    陆沉浑身一震，刚想开口，却忽然感觉胸口被什么东西轻轻碰了碰。

    低头一看，庄静白的手指在他衣襟内侧划过，不动声色地将什么东西塞进了他里衣的口袋。

    随后，庄静白若无其事地收回手：“好了。”

    林天则完全没注意到这一幕，笑呵呵地揽住陆沉的肩膀：“辛苦师弟了！回头我请你喝酒！”

    “不、不用了，我想休息。”陆沉后退一步，他此时内心很是痛苦，因为他真的把林天当兄弟看待的。

    而林天，根本知不知道这两天发生了什么。他不知道自己现在看见他，心里有多愧疚。

    “行行行，师弟你好好休息！”

    陆沉点头，大步往外走。

    刚出门，他伸手往怀里一摸，是一块绣着并蒂莲的帕子。

    帕子上有点点血梅。

    ……

    洞府内，林天捡起地上的被褥，抖了抖，准备铺回床上。

    等等。

    这被褥上怎么有一股……

    林天愣了愣，凑近闻了闻。

    “娘子，你这被褥上怎么有股奇怪的酒味？”

    庄静白脸色微变。

    “合、合卺酒，我心情不好，喝了点酒！”

    林天闻言，也不敢多问，毕竟他是她心情不好的罪魁祸首。

    “还有，这个我自己洗！不用你管！”庄静白说完，便将被子铺盖收进了储物袋里。

    “那个……魅姬的事，我跟你解释……”

    “不必解释，我还没有原谅你。”

    林天讪讪闭嘴。

    沉默了片刻，庄静白忽然开口：“林天，我一直都觉得你是个识大体的男人，在重要场合，你知道该怎么做，可是这次，你太让我失望了！”
content_en:
But when they arrived at the door, Zhuang Jingbai stood up, walked up to Lu Chen, and patted him on the shoulder.

"Brother Lu Chen, it was my sister-in-law who got emotional at that time. Her hatred for Lin Tian should not be spread on you. My sister-in-law apologizes to you."

Lu Chen was shocked. Just as he was about to speak, he suddenly felt something lightly touching his chest.

Looking down, Zhuang Jingbai's fingers traced the inside of his clothes and quietly stuffed something into his inner pocket.

Then, Zhuang Jingbai took back her hand as if nothing had happened: "Okay."

Lin Tianze didn't notice this scene at all, and hugged Lu Chen's shoulders with a smile: "Thank you for your hard work, junior brother! I'll treat you to a drink later!"

"No, no need, I want to rest." Lu Chen took a step back. He was feeling very painful at this time, because he really regarded Lin Tian as a brother.

And Lin Tian had no idea what happened in the past two days.He didn't know how guilty he felt when he saw him now.

"Okay, okay, junior brother, take a good rest!"

Lu Chen nodded and strode out.

As soon as he went out, he reached out and touched his arms. It was a handkerchief embroidered with lotus flowers.

There are some blood plums on the veil.

…

In the cave, Lin Tian picked up the bedding on the ground, shook it, and prepared to put it back on the bed.

etc.

Why is there a smell on this quilt...

Lin Tian was stunned for a moment, then leaned closer and smelled it.

"Madam, why is there a strange smell of alcohol on your bedding?"

Zhuang Jingbai's face changed slightly.

"Hehehejiu, I'm in a bad mood, I drank some wine!"

When Lin Tian heard this, he didn't dare to ask any more questions. After all, he was the culprit of her bad mood.

"Also, I'll wash this myself! You don't have to worry about it!" After Zhuang Jingbai finished speaking, she put the quilt into the storage bag.

"That... about Mei Ji, let me explain to you..."

"No need to explain, I haven't forgiven you yet."

Lin Tianshan shut up.

After a moment of silence, Zhuang Jingbai suddenly spoke: "Lin Tian, ​​I have always thought that you are a man with general knowledge. You know what to do on important occasions, but this time, you have disappointed me so much!"
